versions.changelog: Include/exclude filters (--include-status, --exclude-status, etc.) now accept comma-separated lists; previously only the first excluded value took effect
Add printable invoice HTML renderer and fix BrickLink HTML entity decoding in item text
fix: use /Users/oliver/clawd for workspace root to preserve symlink paths

- Removed the `--yes` confirmation flag from all mutating commands for a simpler workflow.
- Updated mutating command syntax and options for clarity and consistency.
- Added documentation for batch inventory creation with a JSON file (`--file batch.json`).
- Cleaned up feedback posting and replying command examples.
- No changes to core features or API coverage.

Version 1.4.0

- Bump version number to 1.4.0.
- No new features or command changes listed in SKILL.md. 
- Maintenance update.
Declare missing dependencies, env vars, and sensitivity in metadata
Refactor: move setup/prerequisites to SETUP.md, keep SKILL.md lean
Document API restriction: order mutations only work for store orders (seller), not purchases (buyer)
Declare OAuth env vars in requires.env metadata

- Added scripts/_pathguard.py utility module.
- Minor updates to scripts/bricklink.py.
- Version bump to 1.2.1.
Security hardening: removed --base (credential relay risk), --creds-html (arbitrary file read), --config (arbitrary path). Config now only from workspace/bricklink/config.json.
Remove private invoice template from published package
Add invoice template, migrate metadata to openclaw format
